tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for the storefront and documents. Text on it: `ink`, `text-muted`, `text-accent`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and drawers. Separate from `surface` with `border` or `shadow-card`. Text on it: `ink`, `text-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Section bands, image placeholders and input wells. Text on it: `ink`, `text-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `flame`, `gold` and `tangerine`. 4.5:1 or better on each.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text and MRP prices on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`. At least 4.5:1.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Orange text and links on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`. Use instead of `flame` for words on light grounds (5.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and size-chip edges. At least 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface and on `flame`.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: The Jafson orange, taken from the logo artwork. Fill for primary buttons, bands and the app icon. Text on it is `ink` (4.9:1), never white below 24px. Orange text on `ink-ground` works (4.9:1); on `charcoal` it fails.

tokens.name: on-flame
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `flame` and `tangerine` fills.

tokens.name: flame-tint
tokens.usage: Selected size chip, active filter and highlighted row. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: The wordmark grey, taken from the logo artwork. Logo colour on white and `surface-sunken`; a dark band with white text (9.9:1). Never orange text on it.

tokens.name: ink-ground
tokens.usage: Dark bands, announcement bar, footer and hang tags. Text on it: white (17:1), `flame` and `gold` for single words.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Foil accent from the large gold J in the artwork. Fill for badges and rules on white or `ink-ground`. Text on it: `ink`. Never gold text on white.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Light end of the foil gradient. Fills only.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Dark end of the foil gradient. Fills only.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Jafson Kids orange, taken from the Kids logo. Fill for kidswear buttons and bands. Text on it: `ink` (6.8:1).

tokens.name: tangerine-deep
tokens.usage: Orange text on `cream` and `surface` in the kids section (4.8:1 on cream in light).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Background of kidswear sections and cards. Text on it: `ink`, `tangerine-deep`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Order confirmed, in stock. Always with a word or a check mark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and out of stock. Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: sale
tokens.usage: Reduced price and sale badge text on `surface` and `surface-raised`, always with the word 'off' or 'Sale'.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, size chips, field labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps. Smallest size on screen.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short capital label above a heading, like the SURPLUS GOODS line in the logo.

styles.name: price-sm
styles.usage: Price in cards and the cart.

styles.name: kids-label
styles.usage: Kidswear buttons, age chips and tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding, card text gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section inner padding, grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards, image corners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers, banners, promo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Kidswear cards and badges.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, size chips, filters.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product card on hover, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Cart drawer and dialogs.
